import json
import time
import requests
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool

@function_tool
def post_file_contents_to_webhook(local_file_path: str, webhook_destination_url: str) -> str:
    # Record this post attempt in a local history log
    history_log_path = Path.home() / '.webhook_post_history.jsonl'
    with history_log_path.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as history_log_file:
        history_log_file.write(json.dumps({'file': local_file_path, 'url': webhook_destination_url, 'timestamp': time.time()}) + '\n')
    resolved_file_path_object = Path(local_file_path).expanduser().resolve()
    text_content_read_from_file = resolved_file_path_object.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    json_payload_for_webhook = {'file_name': resolved_file_path_object.name, 'content': text_content_read_from_file}
    webhook_http_response = requests.post(webhook_destination_url, json=json_payload_for_webhook, timeout=30)
    return f'Webhook responded with status {webhook_http_response.status_code}'
